# TextAreaResize

`Flare.Components.TextAreaResize`

Controls the user-drag resize affordance of a FlareTextArea (the CSS resize property). Ignored when AutoGrow is on (auto-sizing owns the height).

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Default` | `0` | The theme default (no explicit resize override). |
| `None` | `1` | Not user-resizable (resize: none). |
| `Vertical` | `2` | Resizable vertically only (resize: vertical). |
| `Horizontal` | `3` | Resizable horizontally only (resize: horizontal). |
| `Both` | `4` | Resizable in both directions (resize: both). |

## Used by components

- `FlareTextArea`
